unit: Abdul Latif Jameel Water and Food Systems Lab (J-WAFS)

labs.pi_title: Director, J-WAFS; Abdul Latif Jameel Professor of Water and Mechanical Engineering, MIT
labs.research_summary: An Institute-wide research center funding and coordinating MIT research on water, food and climate systems, rather than running its own research group.
labs.member_breakdown: Leadership team (Director, Executive Director, senior advisors/founding directors, program directors) plus a large roster of 'Funded Researchers' who are MIT faculty PIs funded by J-WAFS grants in their home departments -- not individually itemized here.
labs.join_notes: J-WAFS lists open staff positions on its own site; MIT PI funding opportunities are separate research grants, not lab positions.
labs.notes: J-WAFS is a funding lab/center, not a conventional PI research group -- its 'Funded Researchers' are MIT faculty whose own labs are recorded in their home departments. Recorded the Director as primary contact; member_count intentionally left null since the bulk of 'members' are externally-funded grantees, not lab staff.
